== Title ==

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">自分の戦闘フェイズにおいて、対象のユーズドデッキにカードがある時に使う。運命数を引き、それらのカードと比べる。同じ運命数を持ったカードがあれば、すべてロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-273o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">人間の近縁種ステネス・シフター。人ごみに紛れるのがうまい。トリントは犯罪者を帝国当局に売り渡して利益を得ている。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Card text:''' Use during your battle phase when there are cards in the targeted Used Pile. Draw destiny and compare it with those cards. All cards with the same destiny are lost.

'''Lore:''' A near-human Stennes Shifter who blends easily into crowds. Trinto profits by turning criminals over to Imperial authorities.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 5
* '''Printed subtype:''' Used Interrupt
